subject: Request: SI pilot credit swap for trial extension
messages:
From: Annalise Chen <annalise@cloudforge.io>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-09-10T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SI-sourced credits to extend pilot (CloudForge / StratusLabs)

Hi Markus / Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Marcus and I at CloudForge are excited to push the StratusLabs pilot into a second phase but procurement hit a snag: their marketplace PO cannot be issued in time for the next milestone.

We have an alternative we can fund on our side: CloudForge can transfer SI-managed promotional credits (vendor-funded) to cover the next 6 weeks if Redwood will accept a swap (marketplace credit allocation -> SI-sourced credit equivalent) and extend the pilot window by 30 days.

Attached is a short usage summary so you can see the runway (usage-report.csv). High level: they consumed ~380k token units in week 1 and are projected at ~1.2M over the extension.

Asks:
- Can Redwood approve a credit-swap workflow for partner-sourced credits?
- If yes, what exact accounting/terms do you need (SOW, invoice, PO text)?

Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Annalise Chen
Head of Partnerships | CloudForge
anna@cloudforge.io

Attachment: usage-report.csv (CSV, 12KB)
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Annalise Chen <annalise@cloudforge.io>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-11T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SI-sourced credits to extend pilot (CloudForge / StratusLabs)

Annalise — thanks for the note and for the usage file. This is doable but we need to document the swap and get approval from Partner Ops and Finance.

A couple quick questions to speed review:
- Confirm the exact credit amount you propose (marketplace USD equivalent or token units).
- Who at StratusLabs will sign the SOW or acceptance? We need a named approver for procurement.

I've attached a simple SOW template we typically use for partner-funded trials and an outline of the accounting we would follow (SOW-draft.pdf). If you can confirm amounts, I will route to Partner Ops and request expedited sign-off.

Proposed next step: 30-min sync tomorrow morning to confirm numbers and finalize SOW.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Partner Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

Attachment: SOW-draft.pdf (PDF, 18KB)
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Annalise Chen <annalise@cloudforge.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-12T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SI-sourced credits to extend pilot (CloudForge / StratusLabs)

Markus / Annalise — looping in the technical side and proposing the swap mechanics we will need from Redwood Ops.

Quick note from my side:
- From the usage file, 1.2M token projection -> recommend 150k marketplace credits (USD equivalent) swapped for 140k SI trial credits on our bookkeeping to match latency/cost assumptions.
- We need an explicit clause that these SI-sourced credits are valid only for the StratusLabs pilot and expire 45 days after activation.
- Partner Ops needs a PO or an email trail from CloudForge confirming funding and a named approver.

I've updated SOW-draft.pdf with the pilot dates and the acceptance criteria (see Section 2). If CloudForge can send a short approval email (template below) naming Marcus Liao as signatory, Partner Ops can process within 48 hours.

Template for approval (one-line reply works):
"CloudForge confirms funding of $___ in partner credits for StratusLabs pilot; Marcus Liao is authorized to sign on CloudForge's behalf."

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call.
Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai

Annalise / Marcus — great, thanks for the fast turn. Partner Ops has signed off conditionally on the swap and Finance will process the bookkeeping as partner credits against D-78321.

What we will do next: 
- Activate 140k SI trial credits for StratusLabs + extend pilot end date by 30 days (activation targeted: 2026-09-15).

If that all looks good I will file the approval and send the activation notice when credits are live. Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick coordination.

-Markus
